name: Weak product design: feature list without users or prioritization
scratchpadNotes: features: map, AR, AI, payments, social, rewards, EV

messages.text: Design a parking finder app for drivers in congested downtown areas.
Great, so the app will have a map that shows all parking spots in the city, and it will use AI to predict which ones are free.
Everyone who drives, so all drivers. Then we add augmented reality so when you hold up your phone it shows arrows to the parking spot.
Drivers usually can't hold up their phone while driving. Any thoughts on that?
We can add voice too. Also a social feature where users can share parking spots with friends, and a rewards program where you get points for parking.
Which of these would you build first, and why?
All of them are important, so I would build all of them together in the first version. We should also add EV charging and car wash booking because those are popular.
How would you know if the app is successful?
If a lot of people download it and give it good ratings, then it is successful.
